results.title: Humanoid Whole-Body Badminton via an Annealed Reinforcement Learning Curriculum
results.snippet: Humanoid robots have demonstrated strong capabilities for interacting with static scenes across locomotion and manipulation, yet dynamic real-world interactions remain challenging. As a step toward fast-moving object interactions, we present an RL training pipeline that yields a unified whole-body controller for humanoid badminton, coordinating footwork and striking without motion priors or expert demonstrations. In badminton, locomotion and striking are tightly coupled, making the final hitting objective difficult to optimize directly due to sparse rewards and conflicting gradients. We addre…

results.title: CHILD (Controller for Humanoid Imitation and Live Demonstration): a Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation System
results.snippet: Recent advances in teleoperation have demonstrated robots performing complex manipulation tasks. However, existing works rarely support whole-body joint-level teleoperation for humanoid robots, limiting the diversity of tasks that can be accomplished. This work presents Controller for Humanoid Imitation and Live Demonstration (CHILD), a compact reconfigurable teleoperation system that enables joint level control over humanoid robots. CHILD fits within a standard baby carrier, allowing the operator control over all four limbs, and supports both direct joint mapping for full-body control and lo…

results.title: HuMI: Humanoid Whole-Body Manipulation from Humanoid-Free Demonstrations
results.snippet: Current approaches for humanoid whole-body manipulation, primarily relying on teleoperation or visual sim-to-real reinforcement learning, are hindered by hardware logistics and complex reward engineering. Consequently, demonstrated autonomous skills remain limited and are typically restricted to controlled environments. In this paper, we present the Humanoid Manipulation Interface (HuMI), a portable and efficient framework for learning diverse whole-body manipulation tasks across various environments. HuMI enables humanoid-free data collection by capturing rich whole-body motion using portabl…

results.title: One-Shot Reinforcement Learning for Robot Navigation with Interactive Replay
results.snippet: Recently, model-free reinforcement learning algorithms have been shown to solve challenging problems by learning from extensive interaction with the environment. A significant issue with transferring this success to the robotics domain is that interaction with the real world is costly, but training on limited experience is prone to overfitting. We present a method for learning to navigate, to a fixed goal and in a known environment, on a mobile robot. The robot leverages an interactive world model built from a single traversal of the environment, a pre-trained visual feature encoder, and stoc…

findings.point: 人形机器人全身羽毛球控制：提出退火强化学习课程，实现无运动先验/专家演示的全身统一控制器，协调步法与击球
findings.evidence: 论文提出退火课程：先用辅助运动目标稳定学习，再逐步移除聚焦击球目标；在真机人形机器人上验证动态真实世界交互
findings.attention: 高：2025年最新工作，针对快速移动物体交互的全身控制难题，真机验证
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆：前沿RL+全身控制结合，真机羽毛球任务具代表性，架构可迁移至其他动态交互任务

findings.point: CHILD 全身人形遥操作系统：紧凑可重构的全身关节级遥操作，支持四肢控制与移动操作，含自适应力反馈
findings.evidence: 系统装入标准婴儿背带，实现全身关节映射与移动操作；自适应力反馈增强操作体验并防止不安全关节运动
findings.attention: 高：解决全身关节级遥操作缺失，硬件紧凑且可重构，真机验证
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆：工程落地价值高，为全身模仿学习提供数据采集基础设施，硬件开源潜力大

findings.point: HuMI：从无人形演示中学习人形全身操作，便携接口绕过硬件后勤与复杂奖励工程
findings.evidence: 提出人形操作接口(HuMI)，利用非人形演示实现人形全身操作；旨在突破遥操作硬件限制与仿真到真机奖励工程瓶颈
findings.attention: 中：2026年最新，解决数据采集瓶颈，但真机部署细节待进一步验证
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆：数据高效学习方向有价值，需关注后续真机实验与开源情况

findings.point: 退火课程学习在稀疏奖励全身控制中的有效性：通过辅助目标引导再逐步退火，解决步法与击球耦合的冲突梯度问题
findings.evidence: 羽毛球任务中运动与击球强耦合，直接优化稀疏奖励困难；退火课程先稳定运动再聚焦任务目标，实现端到端全身策略

results.title: TRUST 2025: SCRITA and RTSS @ RO-MAN 2025

The TRUST workshop is the result of a collaboration between two established workshops in the field of Human-Robot Interaction: SCRITA (Trust, Acceptance and Social Cues in Human-Robot Interaction) and RTSS (Robot Trust for Symbiotic Societies). This joint initiative brings together the complementary goals of these workshops to advance research on trust from both the human and robot perspectives.

# 机器人运动学、控制与 ROS 2 前沿增量快照（2024-2026）

**日期**：2026-11-21 | **领域**：Robot Kinematics, Control & ROS 2 | **检索源数量**：28 条（arXiv 预印本为主，含 2013-2026 年文献）

> **说明**：本报告严格基于提供的 28 条证据源撰写。ROS 2 生态演进、产业落地、政策地缘、资本生态等维度在当前证据集中**缺乏直接覆盖**，相关判断均标注 `> 待核实`。所有关键论断均附引用编号 [n]；四类证据（热度、权威、关注度、推荐度）若无对应源则标注 `> 待核实`。

---

## 1. 进展与热点（Progress & Hotspots）

**增量判断**：近 1-2 年核心增量集中在**人形全身统一控制器的端到端 RL/扩散策略落地**、**全身遥操作硬件系统工程化**、**跨本体演示迁移**三大方向；仿真到真机的域随机化系统性研究开始支撑扩散策略迁移。

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点（Bottleneck & Inflection）

**增量判断**：**数据获取瓶颈正被全身遥操作硬件(CHILD)与跨本体学习(HuMI)双路突围**；**稀疏奖励 RL 训练稳定性在退火课程范式下出现拐点信号**；**实时 MPC 求解精度权衡显式化推进工程化落地**；但**仿真到真机域随机化对扩散策略的边界尚不明确**。

| 瓶颈/拐点 | 现状与信号 | 证据支撑 | 判断置信度 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **数据采集瓶颈 → 硬件+算法双路破局** | 传统人形遥操作昂贵、非全身；CHILD 提供紧凑全身硬件 [2]，HuMI 绕过硬件利用异构演示 [3] | [22, 23] | **较大概率** |
| **稀疏奖励全身 RL 收敛难 → 退火课程成拐点** | 羽毛球任务中运动/击球冲突梯度被退火课程化解，实现端到端统一策略 [1] | [1] | **确定**（单任务验证） |
| **扩散策略 Sim2Real 迁移 → 域随机化敏感性待定界** | 系统性研究显示域随机化关键，但最优分布、模态覆盖、计算开销无通用准则 [4] | [4] | **不确定**（需更多任务验证） |
| **全身 MPC 实时性 → 精度-速度显式权衡成工程拐点** | 引入求解精度容忍度换取控制频率，使 MPC 更接近实时部署 [5] | [5] | **较大概率** |
| **触觉融合全身控制 → 从视觉主导向多模态闭环转型** | 分布式触觉实现多接触力控制，补足视觉盲区 [6] | [6] | **推测**（早期验证） |
| **算法-工程栈割裂 → 亟需统一开源基准与集成框架** | 顶会论文聚焦策略/算法，缺乏 IK/QP/MPC/状态估计/安全监护/实时调度的端到端开源工程栈 [20, 21, 22, 24] | q3 综合发现 [20, 21, 22, 24] | **确定**（结构性缺口） |
